purpose: check that people with disabilities can use the product, by testing against standards and with assistive technology
entry_criteria: Screens or a working build exist
The target standard and level are chosen
Assistive technology is available for testing
procedure: Run automated checks first to catch the easy failures, and fix them.
Test keyboard use: every function reachable, visible focus, logical order and no traps.
Test with a screen reader on the main tasks, checking names, roles, labels and announcements.
Check contrast, text resizing, zoom, motion and use of colour as the only signal.
Record each issue with the standard criterion, severity, location and the fix.
Retest fixes and report the remaining issues with owners and dates.
acceptance_criteria: Automated and manual checks both ran
Main tasks work with keyboard and screen reader
Each issue cites a criterion and severity
Remaining issues have owners and dates

validation.command: npx pa11y http://localhost:3000   # example; use the project's checker and URL
validation.expect: no errors reported on tested pages

validation.check: complete the main task using only the keyboard and again with a screen reader

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Automated checks find missing form labels; a keyboard test finds a modal that traps focus; a screen reader test finds an unlabeled icon button. All three are logged with criteria and fixed, then retested.
